title: Underground cities of Turkey

tellings.quote: This is quite a famous phenomenon in Turkey that there are huge cities. They look like ant farms on an enormous scale that are dug out under the earth.

plain: Turkey has huge cities dug out under the earth, looking like enormous ant farms, according to the writer on lost civilisations Graham Hancock. He tells Jesse Michels this as a well-known phenomenon, raising it as a sign that ancient people built ambitious hidden places underground.
